title: Implement Binary Search
description: Implement an efficient binary search algorithm to find an element in a sorted array.
context: Binary search is an efficient algorithm for finding an item in a sorted list. It works by repeatedly dividing the search interval in half. You need to implement this algorithm correctly and efficiently.
requirements: Create a function named 'binary_search' that takes a sorted array and target value
Return the index of the target if found, -1 if not found
Use the binary search algorithm (not linear search)
Time complexity should be O(log n)
Handle edge cases like empty arrays
success_criteria: Algorithm is truly binary search (logarithmic time)
hints: Keep track of left and right pointers
Compare target with middle element and adjust pointers
